title: rosa canina f. tomentella
intro: Rosa canina f. tomentella, commonly known as a variant of the wild rose or dog rose, is a shrub-like plant that belongs to the family Rosaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, and its health benefits include being a rich source of antioxidants, anti-inflammatory compounds, and vitamins, making it beneficial for skin and digestive health. The therapeutic actions of Rosa canina f. tomentella include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which make it useful for wound healing, reducing inflammation, and fighting off infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and ascorbic acid, which contribute to its therapeutic actions and health benefits.
